ai_notes: Original title does not contain the old CSV/filename phrase electro-optic-modulation-based. Verified against the first page and publisher title.
Legacy15.5 gain, detector QE92%, and loss-corrected-8.7dB are not preserved as reported observations: use approximate15/16 in their own contexts, unknown QE, and slope-derived-8.7dB.
Reported delta-8MHz has no printed algebraic sign definition; retain it without assuming a standardized delta.
The p.6 statement that bandwidth decreases0.8GHz conflicts with the MHz-scale spectra. Do not silently use0.8GHz as a quantitative calibration target.
All records have been inspected; this paper is not an untouched future holdout.
